tourNewReviewDescription: Select New review to open the home page, paste a GitHub PR URL, choose a report language, then preview and confirm analysis. Replay this guide anytime using the question mark in the top bar.
tourFilterDescription: Your reviews appear below. Filter by repository, PR number, status or date, then open a task to continue reading its report and handling findings.
tourPrDescription: Paste a full GitHub Pull Request URL here to start a code review. You can replay this guide anytime using the question mark in the top bar.
tourGuestPrDescription: Paste a Pull Request URL from a public GitHub repository to try a review without signing in. Replay this guide anytime using the question mark in the top bar.
tourLanguageDescription: Choose the language for the generated report. It is independent of the interface language; switching the interface does not change existing reports.
tourPreviewDescription: Select Preview PR to check the changes. Read and accept the code-sharing notice, then select Start analysis. The result page shows progress and the report.
tourOpenDescription: Enter a task ID here to reopen a report. Guest reviews also require their corresponding guest token.
tourGuestOpenDescription: Enter the task ID and guest token to reopen a report. Save the full result link; after closing this tab, you will need your saved link or token to return.
tourAccountDescription: Sign in or register to manage review history, adjust analysis preferences and compare versions. Existing guest reports still use their original result links.
tourHistoryDescription: Open Review history to find your reviews, filter by repository or status, and continue working through a report.
tourCrossTasksDescription: Select Review history in the sidebar to see previous reviews and try the filters.
tourCrossSettingsDescription: Select Preferences in the sidebar to see how to adjust your reviews.
tourCrossHomeDescription: Select New review in the sidebar to return to the home page.
tourFinishDescription: You have visited New review, Review history and Preferences. You are ready to get started.
tourSettingsDescription: Use the navigation on the right to jump to check categories, ignored directories and analysis limits. You can also adjust appearance and language here.
tourOverviewDescription: Overview brings together the change summary, risk distribution and key files. While analysis is running, you can also track its progress here.
tourFilesDescription: Read the Diff in File changes, switch between unified and split views, and follow risk markers to inspect the code.
tourIssuesDescription: Open Risk issues to examine evidence and suggested fixes, jump to the code, and record your decision by accepting, revising or marking a false positive.
tourCompareDescription: When a PR has multiple comparable review versions, check which issues are new, resolved or still present.
tourExportDescription: Once a report is available, download it as Markdown to keep a copy or discuss it with your team. Export stays disabled until a report is generated.
tourShareDescription: Use Copy guest link to save the full access URL and return before it expires. The link contains access credentials, so share it only with people you trust.
expiredReadOnly: This older report is read-only. Analyze the current version to edit suggestions or feedback.
guestExpiryUnknown: Guest results are available while the link is valid. The expiry is configured by the server.
guestStorageHint: This tab remembers access to this review. After closing the tab, reopen it using your saved guest link.
guestLinkExpired: The guest link is invalid or expired. Obtain a valid link or analyze the PR again.
lineShifted: The matched issue has moved. Check its location in both versions.
lowMatchConfidence: Low-confidence match. Verify that these findings refer to the same issue.
taskInProgress: An analysis of this commit is already running. Open that task or wait for it to finish.
idempotencyConflict: This operation conflicts with the previous submission. Refresh the page before trying again.
comparisonInvalid: Choose two completed or partially completed analyses of the same PR.
stateConflict: The task state has changed and this action is unavailable. Refresh and try again.
invalidInput: Invalid input. Check the form values and try again.
accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact an administrator.
usernameExists: This username is already taken. Choose another one.
taskError1: The PR is invalid or does not exist.
taskError2: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later.
taskError3: You do not have access to this repository.
taskError4: Fetching GitHub data failed or timed out.
taskError5: The Diff exceeds the analysis size limit.
taskError7: The model returned an invalid response format.
guestDescription: Analyze a public GitHub PR, read the report and review findings without an account. Save your result link to return before it expires.
guestAnalyzeDescription: Paste a Pull Request from a public repository. Preview it, then confirm to start analysis.
guestSaveLinkCopy: This tab remembers access to your review. After closing it, reopen your saved link. The result page shows the expiry supplied by the server.
guestAccessDescription: Open your saved result link, or enter the review ID and guest token below.
guestAccessHint: If this tab already remembers access, you only need the review ID.
guestAccessRequired: Enter the guest token or open your saved result link.
guestAccountDescription: Sign in for personal history, analysis preferences and version comparison. Existing guest reviews remain accessible through their original result links.
analyticsDescription: Explore review activity and task elapsed time for your account.
analyticsActiveDaysHint: Days with at least one new task
analyticsActivityChart: Review tasks created each day in the selected period
analyticsDurationChart: Total time from creation to completion for tasks created each day
analyticsNoData: No data in this time range
analyticsMethod: Method: reviews are counted by creation date. Elapsed time runs from task creation through completion, including queue and wait time. In progress tasks and tasks without a finish time are excluded.
tagline: Understand every change. Focus on real risks.
deskImageAlt: A sunlit code review desk with a laptop, printed code and an orange pencil.
deskCaption: Tools find the clues. You make the call.
privacy: Analysis sends code changes and necessary context to the configured model service. Confirm you are authorized to submit this code.
analysisUnavailable: Analysis is not available yet. Preview, creation, cancellation and retry are unavailable. You can continue reviewing existing tasks.
comparisonUnavailable: Version comparison is not available yet. Version selection and result views are ready for integration.
deletionUnavailable: Task deletion is not available yet.
reusable: An analysis already exists for this commit
invalidPr: Enter a valid HTTPS GitHub Pull Request URL.
invalidTask: Enter a valid positive integer task ID.
feature1Text: Start with the intent, affected modules and files that deserve your time.
feature2Text: Go back to the Diff. Check the context. Decide whether it is a real issue.
feature3Text: Accept it, revise it or mark a false positive. Keep your reasoning in the report.
logoutConfirm: Are you sure you want to sign out?

registerSuccess: Account created. Sign in with your new credentials.

settingsDescription: Set preferences for your next review. Existing reports retain their original configuration.

localSettings: Guests can save theme and language in this browser. Sign in to save analysis preferences.
settingsInvalid: Select at least one category. Use up to 50 relative directories, without .. or a leading slash.
reportLanguageHint: The interface language changes immediately. Existing reports and exports retain their original generation language.
compareDescription: Compare two analyses of the same PR to inspect summary changes and evolving risks.
matchingWarning: Line shifts and similar titles can cause uncertain matches. Disappeared findings do not prove a fix. Verify manually.
deleteConfirm: Delete this task? It will no longer appear in your review history.
